Две сети одного размера хорошо выучили о: Two same-size networks fit the same demonstrations well: one outputs torques, the other a controller target. Will they control the arm equally well?
Да: обе почти не ошибаются на обучающих: Yes: both make almost no error on training examples
Нет: ошибка в цели остаётся ошибкой в то: No: a target error remains a point error, while a torque error compounds in the loop and takes the arm beyond the demonstrated states
Нет: сеть-моменты всегда точнее, она бли: No: the torque network is always more accurate because it is closer to the motors
В лаборатории 1 сеть-цель с регулятором: In Lab 1, the target network with controller missed by 0.6 cm on average and jittered by 1.3 mm; the torque network missed by 3.2 cm and jittered by 6.3 mm.
The demonstrations were recorded at 50 Hz. Is a torque network that also responds at 50 Hz sufficient?
Да: сеть видит ровно то, что было в данн: Yes: the network sees exactly what was in the data
Не всегда: между ответами сети момент 20: Not always: torque is held constant for 20 ms between network responses, while the controller beneath a target corrects the arm every millisecond
Да, если сеть достаточно большая: Yes, if the network is large enough
На графике моментов в лаборатории 1 у се: The Lab 1 torque chart shows a step every 20 ms. Real robots therefore let the network output targets while a fast loop computes torque: in Helix, the fast network responds 200 times per second and outputs wrist poses, not torques.
Если под сетью стоит импедансный регулят: If an impedance controller sits beneath the network, is the arm safe for every target?
Нет: импеданс ограничивает силу при зада: No: impedance limits force for a given target—roughly stiffness times error—but will also execute a target inside a hot kettle
Классика гарантирует только то, что знае: Classical methods guarantee only what they know. The controller does not check where the network places its target; that requires a separate safeguard, covered in Lesson 8.2.
Остаточная поправка должна быть маленько: Must a residual correction be small relative to the controller command?
Да, иначе это уже не поправка: Yes, otherwise it is no longer a correction
Не обязательно: в лаборатории 2 она держ: Not necessarily: in Lab 2 it supported the pot and supplied about half the torque. What matters is that it is easy to learn and begins at zero
Нет, она всегда больше регулятора: No, it is always larger than the controller output
Поправка учит то, чего не знает модель р: The correction learns what the controller model does not know. Silver et al. zero its final layer so that before training it cannot make the initial controller worse.
У регулятора неточная модель руки. Значи: The controller has an inaccurate arm model. Is the only option to train a network to control the arm from scratch?
Да: регулятор с неточной моделью бесполе: Yes: a controller with an inaccurate model is useless
Нет: можно учить поправку к нему — по од: No: train a correction to it. From one demonstration it placed 8 of 10 pots, while the network from scratch placed only 5 even with 32 demonstrations
Нет: достаточно поднять жёсткость регуля: No: simply raise controller stiffness severalfold
Регулятор уже умеет поднимать, переносит: The controller already knows how to lift, carry, and lower; the correction handles what it does not know. On a real Sawyer arm, a correction to a hand-built controller inserted a block between tilted blocks in 15 of 20 trials; the controller alone succeeded in 2.
Чтобы система была надёжнее, лучше отдат: Should as many layers as possible be neural to make the system more reliable?
Нет: в лаборатории 3 все пять сцен прошл: No: in Lab 3, the design with neural perception and grasp selection but classical path planning and control passed all five scenes
Все четыре слоя-сети прошли три сцены из: The four-network design passed three of five scenes: its path crossed the vase and its neural controller struck the table. The all-classical design also passed three: it failed to recognize the tall mug and would have grasped the bowl at its empty center.
Классический планировщик гарантирует, чт: Does a classical planner guarantee that the arm will hit nothing?
Да, на то он и планировщик: Yes, that is what a planner does
Только то, что есть на его карте: ваза,: Only for obstacles on its map: yes for the vase seen by the camera, no for an object absent from the map
Нет, планировщики всегда хуже сетей: No, planners are always worse than networks
В OK-Robot рука вообще не планирует путь: OK-Robot does not plan an arm path at all: it follows one straight-line grasp trajectory. The authors identify collisions with nearby objects as one cause of failure.
Сеть выдала набросок пути захвата. Кому: A network outputs a sketch of the gripper path. Who should execute it: classical methods or a learned policy?
Всегда классике: путь — её дело: Always classical methods: paths belong to them
Смотря насколько точен набросок: по неро: It depends on sketch precision: on uneven sketches from human video, RT-Trajectory's learned policy picked objects in 100% of trials versus 42% for classical methods; on precise language-model sketches, classical methods opened a drawer more often, 71% versus 60%
Всегда обученной политике: она подстраив: Always a learned policy: it adapts to the scene
Неровный набросок — неточная цель: чтобы: An uneven sketch is an imprecise target. Executing it requires reading the frame to infer where to reach, which is a “what and where” question. Classical methods execute a precise target more reliably. Choose the target representation and its executor separately.
